hypotheses.reasoning: S3 in us-east-1 began returning 500 InternalError and 503 errors on PutObject at 14:56. This made payment-svc's storage write fail, so payment-svc returned 500 to order-service and the gateway returned 500 to clients. The aws-sdk retry quota running out and the long gateway latencies come from retries, not the cause. No earlier errors appear in the logs. The disk and TLS warnings have nothing to do with this.
The SDK retries may have made S3 throttling worse (the 503 asked us to reduce the request rate).

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the AWS status page for S3 in us-east-1. Make the artifact write in payment-svc asynchronous or best-effort: queue it, or write to another region as a fallback, so a charge doesn't fail when the write does. Lower the SDK retries and add backoff.
